patch.value: GH-1561: normalize numeric template-save priority and publish supported options

Reported on2026.10.23: public runTemplatesSave accepts numeric priority0 via Record<string, unknown> but silently omits it, so a later templated item receives priority2. The string0 control and direct numeric create work. Investigate typed save options and pre-write normalization/refusal.
Supported numeric template priorities survive save/create or unsupported inputs are rejected actionably before saving; the public SDK option type documents accepted values.
